name: spine-web
description: Spine X-ray measurement local web apps (Spinopelvic PI/PT/SS/LL/SVA, Cervical C2C7/T1S/SVA, ...)

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && PAGE=home vite build && PAGE=spinopelvic vite build && PAGE=cervical vite build && cp dist/index.html index.html && mkdir -p apps/spinopelvic apps/cervical && cp dist/apps/spinopelvic/index.html apps/spinopelvic/index.html && cp dist/apps/cervical/index.html apps/cervical/index.html
